name: figma-design-workflow
description: Figma Design Toolkit: editable Figma/FigJam workflows, local HTML to Figma rich clipboard capture, visual QA and source-faithful design iteration.

interface.longDescription: Seven focused skills for Figma and FigJam operation, local offline HTML-to-Figma clipboard capture, Stitch transfer, visual QA, design references and iteration. Local capture uses a pinned converter and native rich clipboard readback.
defaultPrompt: Prepare visual references or import Stitch screens into editable Figma layers.
Review these Figma screens and fix the key visual issues.
Build an editable FigJam workshop board and verify its editor behavior.
